description: This file contains GUI-related functions and logic for managing 'converters' in the BORIS software, including adding, modifying, deleting, loading from file or repository, and converting code snippets into executable functions.

methods.name: pb_code_help_clicked
methods.description: Displays help information about writing converters.

methods.name: add_converter
methods.description: Enables input fields for adding a new converter and disables other UI controls.

methods.name: modify_converter
methods.description: Prepares UI for editing the selected converter, populating fields with current data.

methods.name: code_2_func
methods.description: Converts a Python code string into a function definition string with a specified name.

methods.name: save_converter
methods.description: Validates and saves a new or modified converter, executing its code to check for errors.

methods.name: cancel_converter
methods.description: Cancels the current add/edit operation and resets UI controls.

methods.name: delete_converter
methods.description: Removes the selected converter after user confirmation.

methods.name: load_converters_from_file_repo
methods.description: Loads converters from a JSON file or remote repository, allowing user to select and import them.
